title: Introduce Soft Handoff Orchestrator for Regional Fallbacks and SLO Safepointing
author: Aisha Moreno
description: Motivation: we see recurring hard cutovers during regional failovers that cause SLO regressions when KV cache state and circuit states diverge. This PR introduces a Soft Handoff Orchestrator that coordinates epoched, rate-limited traffic shifts for regional fallbacks and restores while preserving per-tenant SLO safepoints and enabling rollback without losing circuit/kv context. Summary: add a lightweight orchestrator service and runtime hooks that: 1) capture delta-based circuit snapshots (circuit snapshotting) and KV prefix checkpoints; 2) establish SLO safepoints (per-tenant epoch markers) before shifting traffic; 3) perform rate-limited, canary-backed handoffs with automatic SLO regressions detection; 4) support graceful drain + resume using snapshot deltas instead of full replays; 5) expose metrics and console dashboards for handoff health. Includes operator-facing config: reroute.policy.soft_handoff.window, reroute.policy.soft_handoff.canary_fraction, and slo.safepoint.retention. Design notes: the orchestrator coordinates across regions using existing control-plane gossip and uses lease epochs to avoid double-active states. Handoff proceeds in stages: mark-safepoint -> snapshot-delta -> canary-shift -> monitor-slo -> ramp->commit. If SLOs degrade above thresholds, orchestrator runs automated rollback and replays deltas to preserve consistency. Testing: unit tests for snapshot/restore, an integration e2e harness that simulates KV drift and controlled failovers, and a new load-profile benchmark to validate safepoint timings. Backwards compatibility: runtime hooks are opt-in via feature flag soft_handoff.enabled=false by default. Operator docs and a runbook are included. Checklist: - [x] core orchestrator implementation - [x] runtime snapshot/delta APIs - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] console dashboards and alerts - [x] docs/runbook and upgrade notes - [x] canary rollout on staging. Related: ENG-9428 (regional handoff reliability), SRE-289 (post-incident followup).

release_notes: Add Soft Handoff Orchestrator to enable progressive regional failovers without hard cutovers.
New operator configs: reroute.policy.soft_handoff.* and slo.safepoint.retention.
Opt-in via feature flag soft_handoff.enabled=false by default; recommended staged rollout.
